title: phit
tagline: Regression, mixed models, and probability distributions for PHP.
summary: Fit statistical models, compute probability distributions, and summarize data in PHP. Model functions accept formulas or explicit designs and return fit objects that print like R's and read like arrays.
requires: unzip or the PHP zip extension

verify.note: PHP-FPM reads its own php.ini, so enable the extension there and restart FPM.

evidence_gaps.benchmarks: No benchmark times formula parsing, predict(), descriptive statistics, kernel densities, or chunked CsvReader reading.
evidence_gaps.verification: The reference comparisons ran on macOS; Linux and PHP-FPM runs of them are not recorded, though the release workflow installs and checks every Linux binary.
